predecessors.name: Eretnids
predecessors.text: the Eretnid lands left in 1380-1381 (the 1378 realm without Amasya, Niğde, Aksaray, Ankara and the east)

successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: the Eretnid lands left in 1380-1381 with Amasya

ledger.x: 1381: 'In 1381, he took over Eretnid lands and claimed the title of sultan for himself.'
1381: 'Later that year, Burhan al-Din defeated his main rival, Haji Shadgeldi of Amasya, and declared his sovereignty in Sivas.'
1398: Burhan al-Din is killed in July-August 1398 fighting Qara Yuluk Osman; his son 'sought help from Bayezid I, who dispatched his eldest son with an army of 40,000 troops.
1398: the state ends with Burhan al-Din's death; Zeynal's weeks of rule run into 1399 on one sentence.

wars.name: Mamluk campaigns against Burhan al-Din
wars.outcome: 'Burhan al-Dīn was defeated by the Mamluks in 1387 but soon allied with them'; 'the Mamluk army laid siege to Sivas for several months in 1388 but failed to defeat Burhan al-Din'.

wars.name: Ottoman campaigns against Burhan al-Din
wars.outcome: 'That same year [1390], Bayezid launched several campaigns against him, capturing some fortresses and cities'; none is named.

wars.name: Battle with Qara Yuluk Osman
wars.outcome: Burhan al-Din 'was killed in the Karabel region during a battle with Qara Yuluk Osman' (July-August 1398; the Ottoman historian Saadeddin places it 'in the Harput Mountains').

certainty.note: Only the Eretnid core is drawn.
